title: Ghost Bands of Pittsburgh
summary: This article explores the pre-internet DIY music scene by recounting a 1989 Pittsburgh concert where a pre-fame Nirvana shared a bill with obscure local bands Worm Mart and Ver-men from Venus. It reflects on the nature of memory and the underground music community, celebrating how the history of these forgotten bands uniquely survives through oral tradition rather than digital archives.
